apply_to: every accepted result, including first and terminal-unapplied results
delay_location: IPC thread after complete packet receive and before result publication
timeout_clock: one second since controller-side release; pending FRESH never refreshes OLD
handoff_scope: all consecutive actual switch events through termination, including failed navigation; initial application excluded
unapplied_scope: audit waiting OLD safety separately; no invented switch boundary
world_anchor: each prediction's own saved observation pose
old_execution_risk: observed OLD-associated intervals overlapping observation-to-release window have swept clearance <0.02 m or corridor clearance <=0; include boundary-straddling intervals conservatively, exclude incoming FRESH intervals
old_wait_motion: sum valid incoming commands from predictions older than FRESH, observation-pose snapshot to actual switch or termination; also report GPU-window and delivery-hold complete intervals
classification: separate geometric class from observed OLD_EXECUTION_RISK; risk takes precedence in combined class; invalid correspondence never becomes consistent/staging/candidate
negative_verdict: no candidate and existing minimum classifiable fraction 0.9; otherwise INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
counterfactual: boundary-entry connectors are offline diagnostics, not original PD execution or no-delay rollouts
